# Cohesion walk walk-02: 40 item-on-target pairs, each on its own spot, real input only.
# Generated by tools/cohesion/gen_walk.py from tools/cohesion/pairs.tsv and setup.json; do not edit by hand.
# Run: bash tools/smoke.sh tools/cohesion/walk-02.txt   then: python tools/cohesion/collect.py run-smoke/smoke-out OUTDIR
@world flat
@gamemode survival
@difficulty easy
@observe 30
wait 40
/gamerule doMobSpawning false
/gamerule doDaylightCycle false
/gamerule doWeatherCycle false
/gamerule doImmediateRespawn true
/gamerule keepInventory true
/gamerule showDeathMessages false
/gamerule spawnRadius 0
/gamerule announceAdvancements false
/time set 6000
/weather clear
/setworldspawn 0 -60 -130
/forceload add -96 -112 96 112
wait 40
/kill @e[type=!minecraft:player]
wait 5
report WALK walk-02 40 pairs

/say PAIR P083
/kill @e[type=minecraft:slime]
/tp @s -47.5 -60 24.5 0 0
/effect give @s minecraft:resistance 999 4 true
/effect give @s minecraft:saturation 999 0 true
wait 5
mecha hopper -48 -60 26 hydraulic_legs
/clear @s
wait 5
/tp @s -47.5 -60 24.5 0 22.3
wait 3
lookpos -47.5 -59.2 26.5
wait 10
/item replace entity @s weapon.mainhand with minecraft:air
/item replace entity @s weapon.offhand with minecraft:air
wait 10
riding PRE-P083
inspect me
inspect aim
report PAIR P083 act key use
key use
wait 12
shot cw-P083
wait 17
inspect me
report PAIR P083 end
/kill @s
wait 15
/kill @e[type=!minecraft:player,x=-54,y=-62,z=18,dx=18,dy=14,dz=18]
/fill -54 -60 18 -36 -48 36 minecraft:air
/fill -54 -61 18 -36 -61 36 minecraft:grass_block
wait 3
/kill @e[type=minecraft:item,x=-54,y=-62,z=18,dx=18,dy=14,dz=18]
/clear @s
riding RESET-P083

# ---- P085: (empty) | BODY | mecha (occupied, Passenger Pod) | a pilot inside, Passenger Pod fitted

wait 17
inspect me
report PAIR P085 end
/kill @s
wait 15

wait 3
bystander remove

/fill -6 -61 18 12 -61 36 minecraft:grass_block
